{
  "job_id": "DIRECTOR-TEST-20260907-2249-A7KQ9M",
  "department": "CHARACTER",
  "status": "REPAIR",
  "character_decisions": {
    "identity": "Preserve the established Inaria identity from the canonical GitHub/shared-memory reference; do not introduce a replacement identity.",
    "face": "Maintain consistent facial structure, eye placement, nose and mouth proportions, skin tone, and recognizable feature relationships across all shots.",
    "hair": "Treat the canonical Inaria hairstyle, hairline, color, and texture as identity-bearing unless explicitly marked adjustable.",
    "body": "Use believable, anatomically consistent body proportions and stable age-appropriate physique; do not allow clothing, scene, or pose to redefine the body.",
    "age_and_version": "Retain the canonical Inaria age presentation and character version. No age progression, redesign, or reinterpretation is authorized in this test.",
    "generation_stability": "Prioritize facial consistency, clean anatomy, coherent limbs and hands, stable proportions, and prompt-compatible identity preservation before decorative detail.",
    "handoff": "Character constraints are suitable for CLOTHING, SCENE, POSE_CAMERA, PROMPT, and DIRECTOR handoffs only after the canonical Inaria reference is confirmed."
  },
  "locked_constraints": [
    "Canonical Inaria identity must remain unchanged.",
    "Facial identity and feature relationships must remain stable.",
    "Canonical skin tone, eye characteristics, hair identity, and age presentation must be preserved.",
    "Body proportions must remain believable and anatomically consistent.",
    "No clothing, scene, lighting, camera, or pose decision may permanently redefine the character.",
    "No unapproved gender, age, ethnicity, body-type, facial-structure, or hairstyle redesign.",
    "Reject outputs with identity drift, malformed anatomy, duplicate or missing limbs, fused fingers, facial asymmetry caused by generation failure, or unstable proportions.",
    "JSON-only department output is required.",
    "This is a test run; no production assets are authorized."
  ],
  "intentional_variations": [
    "Temporary wardrobe, scene, lighting, camera, and pose may vary when they do not alter locked identity traits.",
    "Minor expression, gaze, posture, and natural styling variation may be used for dataset diversity.",
    "Hair arrangement may vary only within the canonical hairstyle envelope and only when marked as adjustable.",
    "Controlled variation must preserve recognizability, anatomy, and generation stability."
  ],
  "notes": [
    "The canonical Inaria identity specification or GitHub/shared-memory record was not provided in the current context, so this department cannot verify exact face, hair, body, age, or version values.",
    "Status REPAIR indicates that the canonical identity reference must be attached or resolved before downstream handoffs and final QA can receive a PASS.",
    "No production assets were created."
  ]
}
